description.value:
Your inner cosmo is a wellspring you can spend. You gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point and the Refocus activity; you Refocus by burning your cosmo for 10 minutes.

Your Techniques are focus spells with the cosmo trait, using your Cosmo DC and your key ability.

Techniques have no rank. Each one heightens once per 2 character levels above the level at which you gained it. You gain your Cloth's Techniques at levels 1, 6, 11, and 16.

Your focus pool increases to 2 points at 7th level and 3 points at 13th level.

Implementation note. Foundry has no rankless spell, so each Technique is a focus spell whose base rank is half the level it is gained at, rounded up (1, 3, 6, 8). Focus spells auto-heighten to half your level rounded up, which reproduces the guide exactly for the 1st and 3rd Techniques and converges correctly at 20th for all four; the 2nd and 4th run one heightening step ahead between odd levels.

To regain Focus Points, see @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Refocus].
